run_planner_service: run the Pyro4 planner service daemon that registers the Planner object on the robot name server
get_short_term_goal: get a short-term navigation goal for the robot using FMM path planning toward a target or goal map
goal_within_threshold: check if the robot is within a distance and angle threshold of its navigation goal
is_traversable: check if a given map location is traversable by looking up the occupancy grid value
review_Planner_class: review the Planner class that wraps FMMPlanner for robot navigation via Pyro4 remote calls
